title: LTX 2.5 - Video & Audio Generation
description: ComfyUI serverless worker for LTX 2.5: text/image/first-last-frame-to-video with audio, pose-loop keyframe workflows (A-B-C-B-A seamless loops), TensorRT RIFE interpolation + upscaling, wildcard prompts and an uncensored Qwen3-VL enhancer. Models auto-download to your network volume on first boot.

input.name: Auto-download models
input.description: Download missing models to the attached network volume at worker boot. Requires a ≥160GB network volume attached to the endpoint — strongly recommended.

input.name: Hugging Face token
input.description: Optional — only needed if you edit models-manifest.txt to pull from gated Hugging Face repos. All bundled models are public.

input.name: Job timeout (seconds)
input.description: Max seconds a single generation job may run before the worker aborts it.

input.name: ComfyUI extra args
input.description: Extra launch flags for ComfyUI. Leave empty: --fast / --use-sage-attention / --async-offload corrupt int8-convrot stacks.
